text:
Which statement describes how a flame test is done?
A
The tip of a clean wire is dipped into the substance and the wire is placed in a blue Bunsen
burner flame.
B
The tip of a clean wire is dipped into the substance and the wire is placed in a yellow Bunsen
burner flame.
C
A wooden splint is lit and is placed above a test-tube containing the gas being tested.
D
A wooden splint is lit, blown out and the glowing splint put into a test-tube of the gas being
tested.
